## New
- Links to other videos in a description show as cards with the video's thumbnail.

## Improved
- Bold, italic and strike-through text in comments now shows as written.
- Links in descriptions and comments can be reached and opened with TalkBack.
- Social links in descriptions look closer to YouTube's link chips.

## Fixed
- Tapping 0:00 in a description's chapter list now jumps to the start instead of reopening the video.
